verdicts.title: Kähler-Einstein metrics and Archimedean zeta functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: While the existence of a unique Kähler-Einstein metric on a canonically polarized manifold X was established by Aubin and Yau already in the 70s there are only a few explicit formulas available. verdicts.title: Universality in long-distance geometry and quantum complexity
